title: Transport
description: How the agency speaks to a syndicate: the wire protocol, its default path and auth mode, and the ceiling of capabilities that protocol can physically support.

kind.description: Dispatch mechanism: a local process invocation, or an HTTP request

handler.description: Provider class in lib/dispatch/provider.py that implements this transport

default_path.description: URI path appended to a syndicate's base_uri (http transports only)

auth_mode.description: inherited: the transport authenticates out-of-band (host session, tailnet identity, CLI login) and the agency holds no secret

capability_ceiling.description: The most any channel on this transport may declare. A channel granting a capability outside its transport ceiling is refused at validation - the protocol simply cannot carry it.
